assets.name: Parasurameswar Temple
assets.reason: 7th-century Sailodbhava period temple, one of the oldest surviving stone temples in Bhubaneswar.

assets.name: Chausathi Yogini Temple, Hirapur
assets.reason: 9th-century hypaethral (roofless) circular yogini shrine with 64 black chlorite idols; iconic heritage destination without authentic photo.
assets.recommended_subject: Circular open-air hypaethral sanctum wall showing interior black stone Yogini sculptures.

assets.name: Baitala Deula
assets.reason: 8th-century Khakhara-style deula with rare Tantric Chamunda carvings; currently represented by neutral SVG placeholder.

assets.name: Brahmeswar Temple
assets.reason: 11th-century Somavamsi architectural masterpiece with four corner shrines (panchayatana); currently using neutral SVG placeholder.
assets.recommended_subject: Full courtyard view of Brahmeswar Temple showing main rekha deula and surrounding miniature corner shrines.

assets.name: Ram Mandir, Bhubaneswar
assets.reason: Prominent central city landmark in Janpath with towering red spires and night illumination.
